description: This file contains the implementation of the command handler for updating customer information in a CQRS setup using MediatR. It handles the update logic, interacts with the customer repository, and maps domain entities to DTOs.

classes.name: UpdateCustomerCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the update customer command, performing data validation, mapping, and repository interaction.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the update customer request asynchronously, retrieves customer data, updates properties, saves changes, and returns the updated customer DTO.
